content: Yisas airangwo ha
Ena Sarebir haung honmil sinamo mibi manbi hamen tangure Maria Magdala Yisas yone engwo bani ongwi. Pirere hamba, hulu hona grang si pera di engwo i dikimia hangwi.
Hanere bli si malgi pire Saimon Pita na kina yu di na tongwi, “Yasuro, pi tege eminga yal Yisas yone engwo bani irai dikimia i banta ongwo hankire uminga yawe.”
Dungure Pita na kina bli hama bare si ominga na iri si homa eminia.
Erere pi hona haminba, gal yamoni dimia hanere maini momingi.
Ena Saimon Pita emgi u pa dire ere ala ongwi.
Pire gal tau dungure gal han ta breng bani yobilungwo gal i para dimia hangwi.
Breng bani yobilungwo gal iwe, gal tau dungwo mala i ta dikima, pi nin bangi dimia hangwi.
Hangure na homa ure ala ogi. Pirere talhan ongwo i hanere, Yisas airungwo pamia, di hanere nomani si pir tegi.
Tega gin iwe, ha maing buku awa ha mining bole Yisas gole ti si hon ere airama dungwo i, na yasu pir po sikibilia.
Sikire ere malgi obilgi.
Maria Magdala hong al i Yisas hangwo ha
Ena Maria yone engwo hona grang aire mole hai me mongwi. Me molere ikwi bole han ala ire olungwi.
Olimba ensel sutani gal pege ware Yisas yone engwo bani yal ta breng hol mongure yal ta kebering hol momia hangwi.
Hangure yasuri Maria yu ditongwi, “Alhuno, ni tal ongwo hai mene?” Dungure Maria yu ditongwi, “Yal ta na pi tege eminga yal irai yone i banta ongure na hankire wa du moliwa.”
Dire si kulu si yaulo ole Yisas mongwo hamba, gumang han po sikungwi.

Sikungure Yisas Maria yu ditongwi, “Alhuno ni talongwo hai mene? Ara wa dune?” Dungure Maria yu di pungwi, Ayo, u sina ya hong yal mongwo pamia di hanere yu ditongwi, “Yahuno, gongwo yal irai i banta olanga nan di na tengere ire nale.”
Dimba Yisas Maria haang dale gala dungwi. Dimia Maria ganulun dire, “Tisao” dungwi.

Dimba Yisas yu ditongwi, “Na Nabe mongwo hamen bani olo hoiya, ni na olo na kulekio. Ulubi mole bli si malgi pire na ena abina hobo yu ditenania. Na ere nalgiwe, ni nan Nabe, ni nan God mongwo nalga pamua.”
Dungure Magdala hong al Maria ha i pirere ere Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi mongwo bani pire ha dungwo meri boling kul tere, “Yisas pi tege eminga yal mongwo hanere wiwa” dungwi.
Gamahobi Yisas hangwo ha
Ena Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi Yuda ari kulung pire hoiri yole ala i mongwi. Momia Sarebir haung girungwo Yisas u gamahobo mongwo sina i molere, “Gir hobo moldinio. Mining bolo molo”, ditongwi.
Tere aling bli nil sungwo beni i tibi ol tere te kula bongwo beni i tibi ol tomia hangwi. Hanere yong horega ongure wai pire gun ere mongwi.
Mongure Yisas hon yu ditongwi, “Ni yalhobi mining bolo molo. Na Nabe na bai nu sungure ya ime wiya. Uga meri na ere ni yalhobi ni bai nu sigere nanua.”
Yu ditere, grang miing pu di tere yu ditongwi, “God Kwiang Holi Spirit ni tegere yon wu binama.

Binangure ari tal nigi dongwo ol wangure God pring pai tenangwo kri di ole tenanga meri God ere para kri di ole ni tenamua. Te kri di ole tekinanga meri God ere para kri di ole ni tekinangure ya iwa monanga pamua,” dungwi.
Tomas Yisas hangwo ha
Ena Yisas u tibi ungwo haung na gina para mole haminba, kwal gir kul engwo tal i yu kul engwo yal taniga haang Tomas hankungwi.

Hankungure gamahobo tau Tomas “Pi tege eminga yal Yisas ungwo haminua” ditomingi. Tominba, Tomas na gina yu di na tongwi, “Na yal i bli nil sungwo aling beni hankio, te bli nil sungwo aling beni are te kula sungwo beni are diralga pir teralga pamba, akia pir tekiwa,” dungwi.

Ena sare ta wai sungure na gamnahobo para weni Tomas ire dire para momingi. Molere hoiri mama yole ere momingi. Mominba, Yisas hon ure sina mongwo tali mole yu di na tongwi, “Ni yalhobi mining bolo molio.”
Dire Yisas Tomas yu ditongwi, “Ni ani miling taniga na ana beni baniya are hano. Hanere ani dalna kula bolga baniya a piro. A pingiwe, na pir na tekinanga paikimia, pir na to.”
Dungure Tomas mole, “Na nan pi tege ega yal monio, na nan God mona di pire pir ni teiwa,” dungwi.
Dungure Yisas yu ditongwi, “Ni omaga na na hania, pir na teno? Tenba, ari tau na na hankinangwo hobi iwe, pir na tere gun ere mole yong miling horega onangure miling panamua,” dungwi.
Buku i bongwo yal Yon nin maing i tibi olungwo ha
Ena Yisas ganba baniya mongwo gin iwe, tal nimni mongwo miki weni ongwo omena haniba, buku bani mining bol ekia.

Yisas tal ongwo tau buku bol egere ni yalhobi hanere, Yisas God wang mongwo pamio, Yisas singaba Kraist mongwo pamio, di pire, haang a yuwo ole moli pire, yal i yulang ire, nomani hon ire, mol pananga panana dire, buku bole ni teiwa.
